content: Let [.] be the greatest integer function. If $\alpha=\int\limits_0^{64}\left(x^{1 / 3}-\left[x^{1 / 3}\right]\right) \mathrm{d} x$, then $\frac{1}{\pi} \int\limits_0^{\alpha \pi}\left(\frac{\sin ^2 \theta}{\sin ^6 \theta+\cos ^6 \theta}\right) \mathrm{d} \theta$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_$ .
